user.title: Approve one reviewed ordinary light
user.description:
Confirm the private driver source, version, purpose and test notes before trusting this version. You do not need to write Python. It executes with full Python permissions in HA; static checks do not prove safety or protocol correctness. Only the bound known host and this one ordinary light are enabled. No discovery or manufacturer configuration changes. A new independent readback is required after each connection.

Complete light identifier: {identifier}. Driver SHA-256: {driver_sha256}.
